text:
elaine: FYI rolling deploy of model v23.9 started ~10m ago. Seeing a rapid increase in GPU queue length on pools in us-west-2. Prefill/warmup looks suspicious.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: GPU_POOL_SATURATION high - 74% of requests queued > 500ms. Pager -> @sre-jordan.
sre-jordan: I'll take it. first glance: many long prefill requests with context lengths > 64k tokens. KV cache hotset increased ~3x. stack metrics: GPU busy 98%, queue depth 420.
ml-dev-amy: we pushed a prefill optimization in v23.9 that aggressively builds kv cache prefetch for long-context customers. Could be filling memory and slowing throughput.
elaine: customers reporting 429/503s? Lin, any customer tickets?
customer-success-lin: getting a couple of elevated error reports from two enterprise customers (alpha-fin and beta-chat). They're seeing timeouts on inference, intermittent 5xx. Logged as P1 for alpha-fin.
eng-lead-carlos: immediate mitigation suggestions? Can we disable prefill for the new model or rollback?
sre-jordan: Options: 1) Scale up GPU pool (manual hot-add) 2) Toggle prefill off via feature flag for v23.9 3) Route traffic to v23.8 fallback 4) Apply ingress throttle to limit concurrent prefills.
ml-dev-amy: We have a runtime flag prefilling=true per model config. I can flip it for v23.9, but warm cache will be lost. That should drop KV pressure quickly.
sre-jordan: I'll start manual pool scale while Amy flips flag. Carlos, can you approve burst capacity increase?
eng-lead-carlos: Approved. Price be damned for now. Deploy-bot: Requested capacity increase to pool-gpu-west-2 submitted (ticket 4729).
elain: small typo: "elaine" :P
ml-dev-amy: flipping prefilling=false for model:v23.9 now -> command:
```
rdwctl model set-config v23.9 --prefill false --apply
```
ml-dev-amy: done. rolling config update across nodes.
sre-jordan: monitoring KV free memory and queue depth.

sre-jordan: Logs from runtime showing KV spills and eviction thrash:
```
[2026-03-15T21:12:03Z] kv_cache: reserve failed 0x7f... size=24MB try_evict=1
[2026-03-15T21:12:04Z] pager: spill-to-disk triggered for model v23.9 instance=gpux-45
[2026-03-15T21:12:04Z] runtime: request queued (prefill) latency=1120ms queue_len=410
```

sre-jordan: After prefilling=false, queue depth dropped from 420 -> 180 in ~3m. GPU busy to 84%. Some tail latency still high due to KV eviction.
product-sam: What's customer impact short-term? Do we need an incident bridge?
customer-success-lin: alpha-fin is still seeing timeouts but at lower rate. Beta-chat reported degraded responsiveness. I'll open a status page update draft.
eng-lead-carlos: Can we route alpha-fin to v23.8? They have a contract; let's give them dedicated fallback to reduce impact.
ml-dev-amy: Can create a model-routing rule to pin their traffic to v23.8 by customer_id, doing a canary rollback. Doing now: `rdwctl routing add-rule --customer alpha-fin --model v23.8`
ml-dev-amy: rule added. Confirming their requests now hitting v23.8.
sre-jordan: Queue for alpha-fin dropped to single digits. Overall queue stabilized ~120. Need to watch autoscaler: it hit max replicas earlier and refused further scale due to pool quota.
eng-lead-carlos: Note for postmortem: request quota/scale limits should be revisited. We should be able to burst more automatically.
deploy-bot: Autoscaler event: scale_failed - reached max_replicas 48 for gpu-pool-west-2 at 21:10:31Z.
sre-jordan: I'm going to temporarily increase max_replicas to 80 to allow scale to continue while we keep prefills off. Increasing now.
sre-jordan: command: `infractl pools set-max-replicas gpu-pool-west-2 80 --reason "incident: kv spike"` -> done. Autoscaler resumed scaling, +12 replicas in 90s.
ml-dev-amy: Note: turning prefill back on without kv tuning will re-trigger. We need a controlled warmup strategy (throttle concurrent prefill, rate-limit per-customer).
customer-success-lin: I'm posting to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating elevated latency and errors for hosted inference in us-west-2; mitigation in progress. Some customers routed to previous model. No data breach." Will link later.
product-sam: Please add customer-affecting list to the post: alpha-fin (P1), beta-chat (P2).

sre-jordan: Handing off to night SRE @sre-night for long-tail monitoring. Summary: prefilling on v23.9 caused KV growth -> eviction -> GPU queue growth -> autoscaler hit pool max -> request throttling. Immediate mitigations applied: prefilling disabled for v23.9, alpha-fin routed to v23.8, manual pool burst to 80 replicas, ingress throttle applied to prefill-heavy routes.
sre-jordan: Handoff notes: watch queue depth, KV free mem, autoscaler events, and customer error rates. escalation_contact: eng-lead-carlos.
sre-night: acknowledged. taking over monitoring.
ml-dev-amy: follow-ups for tomorrow: add per-customer prefill concurrency limit, safe warmup window, and KV quota per-instance. Also bake a fallback routing rule for high-KV models.
eng-lead-carlos: assign postmortem owner: @ml-dev-amy. Add SLA impact calc and cost delta for burst.
customer-success-lin: I'll follow up with alpha-fin directly and share the mitigation steps.
product-sam: Thx all. If anything regresses alert oncall.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved? condition: queue_depth < 100 && 5xx_rate < 0.5% for 10m. Currently queue_depth=72 5xx_rate=0.3% -> marking as mitigated.
elaine: closing thread. postmortem template link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-template
